title: 002 - Sum Even Numbers
prompt: Fix the bug so the program sum only the even numbers from the sample list and prints exactly `10`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function sumEvenNumbers(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 1));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function sumEvenNumbers(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 0));
}
hint: The condition should keep even values, not odd ones.
explanation: The bug checks the wrong remainder. Changing the condition to keep values divisible by 2 fixes the total.
